arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/memtest.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource, os
name = sys.argv[1]
spec = json.loads(open('/workspace/cases/%s.json' % name).read())
data = json.dumps(spec).encode()
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/cli.py'],
                   input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
dt = time.time() - t0
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
ok = p.returncode == 0 and p.stdout.startswith(b'{"runs":')
print('%-30s %6.2fs in=%5.1fMB out=%5.1fMB rss=%5.0fMB %s'
      % (name, dt, len(data)/1e6, len(p.stdout)/1e6, ru.ru_maxrss/1024,
         'OK' if ok else 'FAIL ' + p.stderr.decode()[-500:]))
PYEOF
mkdir -p /workspace/cases && cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
# memory-adversarial: big backlog, 64 saves spread over maximal tree churn
ev = [["enqueue", i, 1, 100, (i*7919) % 100000] for i in range(60000)]
for k in range(64):
    ev += [["dequeue", 1] for _ in range(600)]
    ev.append(["save", k])
    ev += [["dequeue", 1] for _ in range(1)]
json.dump({"runs":[dict(banks=4, load_balancers=2, fifo_bytes=2**31-1,
  pifo_bytes=2**31-1, refill_batch=32, sample_period=100000,
  borders=[0,50000,100000], policy={"kind":"sff"}, events=ev)]},
  open('cases/mem1.json','w'))

# churn with transfers: small pifo forces constant fifo<->pifo movement
ev = [["enqueue", i, 1, 100, (i*7919) % 100000] for i in range(60000)]
ev += [["save", k % 64] for k in range(64)]
ev += [["dequeue", 1] for _ in range(39000)]
for k in range(64):
    ev.append(["save", k])
json.dump({"runs":[dict(banks=2, load_balancers=2, fifo_bytes=2**31-1,
  pifo_bytes=2000, refill_batch=32, sample_period=100000,
  borders=[0,50000], policy={"kind":"sff"}, events=ev)]},
  open('cases/mem2.json','w'))

# 64 saves interleaved with enqueue bursts (growing versions, then restores)
ev = []
for i in range(60000):
    ev.append(["enqueue", i, 1, 100, (i*7919) % 100000])
    if i % 940 == 0:
        ev.append(["save", i // 940])
    if i % 940 == 470:
        ev.append(["restore", (i // 940) % 63])
json.dump({"runs":[dict(banks=4, load_balancers=2, fifo_bytes=2**31-1,
  pifo_bytes=2**31-1, refill_batch=32, sample_period=100000,
  borders=[0,50000], policy={"kind":"sff"}, events=ev)]},
  open('cases/mem3.json','w'))
EOF
cd /workspace && for c in mem1 mem2 mem3; do python3 memtest.py $c; done
